no-restricted-syntax.message: No hex color literals in inline style objects. Use a CSS custom property token (hsl(var(--color-...)) or var(--shadow-...)).
Bare text-2xs / text-3xs is prohibited. Use it only behind a responsive prefix (e.g. md:text-2xs), or use text-xs.
Arbitrary font sizes below 12px are prohibited (typography.md restricted sizes). Use text-xs, or md:text-2xs / md:text-3xs in permitted dense-UI contexts.

Tailwind named-color utility classes are discouraged. Use semantic tokens (bg-card, text-foreground, border-border, text-success, etc.). NOTE: enforced at error in v3 — eslintrc cannot split severities within a single no-restricted-syntax invocation; there are zero existing violations so this does not break the build.
